approvedRows.desiredState: CodeWiki proves normal project-local mutation without override, warns on non-project installs, documents sandbox compatibility, and lists unattended automation gates.
approvedRows.rationale: These are the last readiness controls before testing CodeWiki in a different real repository.
approvedRows.userImpact: Improves user outcomes by preserving clear project intent.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Keeps implementation cost bounded and reviewable.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.

agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Improves CodeWiki while preserving trace-backed source truth.
agentAssessment.rationale: No lower-cost alternative better serves the user and project.

approvedRows.safetyBoundary: Normal mutation must work from a project-local Pi install and production automation remains gated until the checklist is satisfied.
failureModes: Read-only UX hides non-project install risk.

approvedRows.negativeTestPlan: Run project-local install smoke, install-scope unit tests, external package smokes, and readiness checks.
approvedRows.compatibilityImpact: Read-only use stays allowed; mutation policy and docs become stricter and clearer.
approvedRows.currentPain: The current behavior leaves project intent less structured than it could be.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: The decision creates a clearer, more useful project outcome.
approvedRows.successSignal: Planning can consume the decision without additional intent clarification.
